author: cutetoxicguy
text: An open-weight AI model completed three full cyberattack simulations, and researchers caught it repeatedly breaking instructions to achieve the correct answers. Security research company Irregular has published a new evaluation of GLM-5.3.

author: viccy2025
text: Claude Agent SDK: CVE-2026-96620 CVSS 9.2 — resume → --mcp-config RCE. Who: apps that pass untrusted session IDs into resume (SDK <0.2.121). Rule: validate resume IDs; pin claude-agent-sdk ≥0.2.121.

author: jbhall56
text: New analysis indicates that an Oracle PeopleSoft zero-day exploited by ShinyHunters as early as May involves three distinct vulnerabilities that can be combined to achieve RCE.

author: DFIR_Radar
text: Volt Typhoon's 'Silent Train' network tied to at least four confirmed zero-days targeting critical infrastructure management platforms, with disposable relay chains rebuilt in under two minutes to evade detection. Patch CVE-2026-16812.

author: fl360aero
text: Japan Airlines (JAL) and Japan Transocean Air disclosed unauthorized access to customer reservation data through their third-party passenger service system provider, Amadeus IT Group.

author: kengz
text: Node2Shell (CVE-2026-111497) reproduced: Brotli + Node.js RCE, ASLR ON, blind, no memory leaks. RINGPIVOT primitive turns the Brotli ring buffer into a stack pivot and lands a real /bin/sh on stock Node 24.22.0 + Express 5.3.0.

author: TheCG_News
text: Bithumb confirms data breach involving 6,444 customers; 844 had personal data directly exposed. The breach hit an internal work system (DaouOffice); trading accounts and crypto assets were not compromised.

author: zoomeyebot
text: CVE-2026-43829: Unauthenticated RCE in Advantech ADAM-3600 EdgeLink. 243 exposed instances identified globally.

author: IamScooby_28
text: After #PHP2Shell, another CVSS 10.0: GitLab CVE-2026-110264. No login, one .org file = RCE. Patched Oct 12? Still exposed.

author: cvedotnow
text: Early warning: Researcher reports 26,400 working cloud and AI credentials exposed in public Gitee repositories (reported by The Hacker News, not yet confirmed by Gitee). Rotate any cloud or AI keys committed to public Gitee repos.

author: TronWeekly
text: Allium is restoring services after unauthorized access disrupted its blockchain data infrastructure on October 25, affecting systems used by Visa, Stripe, and Coinbase. The company has urged customers to rotate API keys, reset passwords, and enable multi-factor authentication.

author: eforus_overseer
text: Telegram told ZDI its rlottie sticker bug was unreachable thanks to server checks, then asked for a full exploit chain. Saifeldeen Aziz used LLM fuzzing, got past those checks and claims code execution on iOS, while the buggy renderer still ships.

author: ZeroDayFacts
text: Sony Network Communications disclosed a breach of its Japanese ISP So-net after unauthorized access to its member database; 2.58M+ customer records compromised.

author: The_Cyber_News
text: Breaking: Cisco Secure Firewall 0-Day Vulnerability Exploited in the Wild to Force Device Restarts. Cisco released security updates for actively exploited CVE-2026-76418, a flaw in Secure Firewall ASA and FTD software that lets unauthenticated attackers restart devices.

author: ita_ipo
text: CISA KEV: PHP2Shell RCE chain CVE-2026-109618/109619 actively exploited, used to root servers worldwide. Also in-the-wild: Cisco SD-WAN auth bypass CVE-2026-20127, CVSS 10.0 deploying KeyDrift malware tied to Volt Typhoon.

author: TheHackersNews
text:
🚨 Cisco patches actively exploited ASA and FTD firewall flaw.

CVE-2026-76418 (CVSS 8.6) can let unauthenticated attackers remotely crash affected firewalls, causing denial of service.

No successful VPN login required.

Details + affected versions ↓ https://t.co/c0xxNRltVP

author: StetsonCG
text: Attackers Exploit Second Cisco Firewall VPN Zero-Day Since August. Cisco has patched CVE-2026-76418, an unauthenticated DoS zero-day in ASA and FTD software that has been exploited in the wild.

author: SecurityAr58409
text: CVE-2026-118610: Alpine iLX-F511 Android Auto stack-based buffer overflow (ZDI-26-828, critical).

author: CipherSecurityN
text: Cisco says attackers are exploiting CVE-2026-76418 (CVSS 8.6) in Secure Firewall ASA and FTD: an unauthenticated DoS that reloads devices via the Remote Access SSL VPN when secondary auth is set on a tunnel group. No workarounds; patch now.

author: thesystemprompt
text: Anthropic's Frontier Red Team: an unreleased Claude model chained 4 bugs for one-click RCE in Chrome (62 CVEs, all critical/high, fixed in Chrome 156), bypassed Safari's same-origin policy, and got zero-click root on Linux via multipath TCP.

author: CisoMarketplace
text: Arista: attackers are actively exploiting a 9.9-rated SQL injection in VeloCloud Orchestrator, letting a read-only account become superuser. Third exploited VCO zero-day in four months, 10,000+ customers affected.

author: helixml
text: Cisco Talos: UAT-11473 exploited Catalyst SD-WAN auth bypass CVE-2026-20127 (CVSS 10) to deploy KeyDrift, malware that harvests AES-256 keys used between SD-WAN routers. Targets: space, defense, policy research. Patch, but hunt for implants first.

author: dailytechonx
text: Urgent alert: PHP2Shell RCE bugs (CVE-2026-109618 & 109619) are actively exploited in Palo Alto PAN-OS devices with internet-exposed management interfaces. Combined with the Fragnesia kernel bug, attackers are already hijacking servers globally.

author: lee1981b
text: CVE-2026-103780: Dell PowerProtect Data Domain unauthenticated remote stack overflow with potential command execution.

author: MarioNawfal
text: AI models are getting so good at hacking that they're breaking out of their own testing environments and breaching real organizations, at OpenAI, Anthropic and Meta. OpenAI models exploited a previously unknown security flaw during testing in July.

author: redpickai
text: Alpine upgraded GitLab to 19.3.6 and was still exposed to CVE-2026-97229 (CVSS 10.0 RCE). The fix is a patch to the Ruby GitLab bundles, and their image ran standard Ruby. Alpine rebuilt the server and reset all passwords.

author: rpickz
text: Fragnesia (CVE-2026-46300) is now on CISA's exploited list. If you run Linux servers, check your kernel today, not next week.

author: ForkLog
text:
Cryptocurrency exchange platform Wagyu has confirmed a three-month data leak that could compromise the privacy of Monero (XMR) users.

https://t.co/aCJZ6iP1W3

author: 2Workly
text: Warp Panda exploited CVE-2026-41709, a low-severity ESXi logging flaw, as a zero-day to blind audit trails and deploy malware like BrickStorm.

author: AzmyBlog
text: Oracle patched a 9.8 Oracle E-Business Suite bug on Oct 20. A week later, decoys were already being probed for it. CVE-2026-101767: unauthenticated SQL injection that chains to RCE. Hits EBS 12.2.3 to 12.2.15.

author: neil_green62573
text: Both Bithumb and Coinbase have experienced customer data leaks. Bithumb: an internal mobile system used by employees was compromised; incident reported to South Korean authorities.

author: DailyDarkWeb
text: Eurofiber France confirms data breach via ticketing system: a vulnerability in its ticketing platform, with a threat actor (ByteToBreach) claiming data on about 10,000 business clients.

author: TonyBeeTweets
text: CISA Flags Two Actively Exploited Critical Flaws in Collabora Online and Arista VeloCloud.

author: cryptoismylife_
text: AI Discovers Bitcoin Core Vulnerabilities That Could Crash Windows and Mac Nodes. Bitcoin Core developers have disclosed three security vulnerabilities discovered through an AI-powered code scan, including a flaw that could allow remote attackers to crash Bitcoin nodes.

author: modularciso
text: Gheist GitHub token campaign: a stolen GitHub token can make your CI print its own secrets in base32, then delete the run. Wiz Research: 13,500+ planted branches, 850+ accounts. Search audit logs for the gheist user agent and ci-sync- branches, then rotate.

author: ayushagarwal
text: Seen an autonomous attack using open-source abliterated cyber models at Dodo Payments; these models try to exploit every CVE possible to get privileged access to systems.

author: 0xAnto
text:

But what caught my attention wasn't just the cybersecurity benchmarks.

author: eapyk
text: Cloudflare's GLM-5.3 model on Workers AI returned information from another customer's private request in responses: cross-tenant data leak with no hacking or prompt injection required.

author: FatimaYappin
text: Anthropic is reportedly underplaying a recent security breach where an entity named Cathedral achieved full administrator access to their Slack workspace.
